description: Welcome to this unique historic loft in the 10th arrondissement, a transformed 19th-century artist's studio turned into a colorful and warm apartment for 6 guests. On the 1st floor without elevator, this spacious property has everything you need: fully equipped kitchen, bright living room with original glass roof, bedrooms with double and single beds, and a bathroom. Some rooms and the bathroom are in mezzanine.The spaceMy atypic historic loft has everything you need to have a pleasant stay. It has been decorated with lots of souvenirs from our travels and retro design objects we love. We wanted to bring color and warmth to this authentic voluminous artist’s atelier from 19th century with original glass roof providing a lot of light. Two bedrooms and a bathroom are accessible by two separate stairs. A large window brings light into the large bedroom upstairs.Historical carved furniture, mirrors and paneling are still present in the third bedroom.☀︎☀︎☀︎ HIGHLIGHTS ☀︎☀︎☀︎WIFI at disposalFully equipped kitchenBed and bath linen providedAnimals accepted : Extra charge of 20€/ day for animals + extra charge of 44€ on the price of the household for the hair❋❋ KITCHEN AREA ❋❋- Oven- Microwave- Two refrigerators and a freezer- Dishwasher- Kettle- French press coffee maker- Hot plate- Several additional kitchen amenities will be available ❋❋ LIVING ROOM AREA ❋❋- A TV + Box/ Wifi + FREE BOX + CHROMCAST- Board games, DVD, books, tapes - A large dining table for 8p.- Armchairs and a sofa - A desk ❋❋ BATHROOM on the upper floor❋❋- Shower - Bathtub- 2 toilets (upstairs in the bathroom) or separate downstairs- Hair dryer- Washing machine - dryer and drying rack- Iron and ironing board ❋❋ BEDROOM SPACES ❋❋- Downstairs, a double bed 140x190, 2 pillows , comforter 200x200- Upstairs on th
